test_pitch: test the pitch effect by comparing sox output to augment.EffectChain().pitch(-100).rate(16000)
test_reverb: test the reverb effect by comparing sox output to augment.EffectChain().reverb(50, 50, 100).channels()
test_bandreject: test the bandreject sinc filter by comparing sox output to augment.EffectChain().sinc('-a', '120', '2000-1000')
run_sox_command: run sox command on a wav file with given parameters and return audio tensor and sample rate
apply_chain: apply an augment EffectChain to a wav file and return the processed audio tensor
